title: tpu-roofline Request
description: Input payload for the tpu-roofline agent. The caller states in `prompt` what it needs a hardware floor for: one op, a block of code, or a whole model on a slice. Everything else is optional context. The agent decides the path and returns `needs_input` when a required choice (hardware, sharding, workload) is missing.

prompt.description: What to model, in the caller's own words: the op, code block or model, and any shapes, dtypes, hardware, sharding or workload the caller already knows.

run_id.description: Identifier of the active TPU agent suite run namespace.

context.description: Optional free-form inputs the caller already holds, for example a config path, a source file, a model id, the slice, the sharding or the workload. Keys are not fixed.

output_dir.description: Optional directory for the outputs. Defaults to the run's artifacts/roofline/ directory.

examples.prompt: Roofline of the MoE down-projection of GLM-5.2 at 8K prefill tokens on one v7x chip, fp8 weights.
Model the GLM-5.2-FP8 serving roofline on v7x 2x2x2.
